Executive Leadership & Strategy

#1 — AI Governance as Competitive Moat: From Compliance Checkbox to Board-Level Imperative — Operations Council / Deloitte

★ Strategic insight for CTO-to-CEO progression—operational governance of AI is becoming a permanent COO/CEO mandate, not a technical silo, positioning AI governance as a value-creation lever in organizational strategy.

Operational governance is emerging as equally significant to legal and compliance considerations in enterprise AI adoption, requiring decisions on how AI recommendations are reviewed, exceptions managed, and performance monitored. As AI becomes embedded in core business processes, operational governance is likely to become permanent in the COO's mandate, with the COO's role becoming increasingly central to AI success and what was viewed as a technology initiative rapidly becoming an operations leadership mandate.
